title: La Murder Le Diablé
summary: A woman is found stabbed at home on new years eve by an intruder wearing a devils mask
method: There were two people responsible for the murder. The first suspect stabbed the woman at her home. A second suspect then attacked the first suspect, making it look like the same person was responsible for both attacks. A worker's clothes and knife were stolen to commit the murder to frame him. They gave him rum that had a sedative in it, then planted the murder weapon after the attacks. The worker could not read or write so he couldn't be responsible for the murder because of the messages the suspects left.
motive: The husband of the victim was having an affair and wanted to avoid an expensive divorce process. His brother needed money to save his failing distillery so the husband gave him money in return for killing his wife. The second attack was purposefully not severe, just to make it look like a serial killer was responsible.
killer: The victim's husband and his brother
